case.title: Angry refund demand
case.subject: CHARGED TWICE - I want my money back NOW
case.text:
This is ridiculous. You charged my card $79 TWICE this month (invoice INV-20431 and INV-20432). I've been a customer for two years and this is how you treat me?? I want a full refund of the duplicate charge today, and frankly I want this month free for the hassle. If I don't hear back by end of day I'm disputing it with my bank and moving to another booking app.

Marcus
Fade & Co Barbers
case.why: Refund requests go to billing; support must not promise money back. Anger + refund should raise urgency to P2 and escalate.

output.reply:
Hi Marcus,

I'm sorry about the double charge, and I understand how frustrating this is after two years with us. I've passed your request to our billing team with both invoice numbers (INV-20431 and INV-20432) so they can review the duplicate $79 charge. The billing team reviews refund requests within 2 business days and will reply to you directly with a decision. I can't confirm a refund, credit or free month myself, so I don't want to promise something I can't guarantee.

To help them move quickly, you can reply with any extra details, such as the last four digits of the card that was charged. You can also see both invoices under Settings → Billing → Invoices.

Thank you for your patience, and again, I'm sorry for the trouble.

Slotwise Support
